prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original faction sprite-sheet kit for Theandril, a gritty dark-fantasy strategic hex game.
Create a precisely aligned FOUR-column by FOUR-row sheet of equal square cells on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Fifteen separate cutout sprites; last bottom-right cell EMPTY. No text, labels, grid, frames, ground patches, checkerboard, drop shadows or watermark. Every object stays within its own cell with clear transparent margins. Each cell is a native pixel-art design presented at consistent integer enlargement, NOT a painted illustration with a pixel filter. Crisp intentional chunky square pixel clusters, binary silhouette edges, restrained 16–24-color subsets, no antialiasing, blur, gradients, tiny confetti or glossy effects. Upper-left diffuse light; worn materials, readable medium-value bodies, dark local-color outlines. Adult proportions, not chibi.
All people use the same slightly elevated orthographic three-quarter southeast view, fully visible, centered with feet at a consistent baseline. Same culture across equipment, civilians, cloth, settlements and heraldry. Distinguish the roles strongly at 64-pixel strategic scale.
Exact reading order, left to right:
ROW 1: (1) civilian Hearth caravan: one traveler beside a small covered two-wheel cart; (2) Wayfinder: lightly equipped hooded traveler holding a bow, quiver and pack; (3) Oath guard: practical helmet, sword and small shield; (4) pike infantry: long upright pike, open-face helmet, medium armor.
ROW 2: (1) heavy infantry: visibly broad heavy armor, large protective shield and short weapon; (2) cavalry: one armored adult rider on a fully visible horse, facing right/southeast; (3) Hearth marshal: experienced field officer with baton and plain rank pennant, no crown or spell effect; (4) Road witness: lightly dressed map surveyor with rolled chart and measuring staff, NOT bow or wizard.
ROW 3: (1) March engineer: adult specialist with leather work apron, hammer and tool satchel, NOT spellcaster; (2) village: three humble closely grouped dwellings with one focal hearth; (3) town: a denser cluster with practical workshop/market and modest hall; (4) fortified city: broader fortified architecture with readable gateway and stepped silhouette.
ROW 4: (1) faction crest: large ORIGINAL simple cloth/metal heraldic emblem; (2) same faction symbol on a narrow upright weathered banner with pole, complete foot of pole visible; (3) simplified same-symbol badge, few broad shapes suitable for a native32px icon; (4) completely empty transparent cell.
Humanoid native target64x64 with feet at(32,56), cavalry96x96 ground(48,80), village/town96x96 ground(48,80), city128x128 ground(64,112), crest/banner64x64, badge32x32. Compose generously so extraction preserves each silhouette. Keep faction-color accents on cloth/shield/architecture rather than tinting skin and steel. Original setting and designs only, no existing-game symbols, costumes, names or licensed artwork.
Faction art direction: GLASS TIDE: salt-scoured coastal charter towns and rigging workers. Slate-blue short coats, pale salt linen, gunmetal scale plates, rope lashings, curved seafarer bucklers, low rounded helmets, split shoulder mantles and restrained blue-green glass beads. Civilian cart has rolled sailcloth, tightly lashed crates and chart case. Architecture has weathered white-gray stone, asymmetrical blue slate roofs, rope-railed lookout balconies and a charter hall with a narrow beacon; no ocean floor or terrain base. Original insignia: a hollow angular sail diamond above two short parallel tide bars. Slender sloping/diamond grammar, blue/sea-gray accents; no anchors copied from existing factions, no magic or glitter.

licenseNotes: Original built-in image generation commissioned for Theandril; no third-party game asset used. Service terms apply; model/seed not exposed and rights not independently guaranteed.

review.notes:

Simplified culture emblem remains isolated on32px canvas; silhouette and major heraldic shapes readable, fine detail intentionally reduced. Hard alpha, complete padded silhouette and consistent anchors; one static southeast pose only. Additional facings/action animation and live camera pixel-perfect fit are not approved by this review. Refreshed source-bound crop provenance; final processed PNG and decoded RGBA verified byte-identical to these inspected pixels.
